note: Code in src/ that reads a stored record with getMemory and later writes the same key back with setMemory or writeMemoryRecord, with no version condition (check:atomic-writes, scripts/inventory/atomic-writes.ts). Seeded 2026-10-18 with every hit read by hand. Each line is one of two things: "Safe: <the fact that makes it safe>", where "not a read-then-write" marks a hit the detector got wrong, or "DEBT: <what two requests or two node processes at the same moment lose or double>", which pnpm debt counts as open. In-process locks and boot chains do not count as safe: aimeat.io has run two node processes on one database (services/scheduler-fire-claim.ts). The list only shrinks: fix a DEBT entry with updateRecord() in services/record-cas.ts or setMemoryIfVersion, then delete its line.
